spec.name: sprint29_predmkt_spread_measure
spec.hypothesis: Kalshi/Polymarket cross-venue spreads on resolution-text-matched markets exceed combined fees, documented 1.5-4.5% (IMDEA); measure before any traded spec.
spec.power_argument: >=300 matched-market-days needed to estimate spread frequency/size before a traded spec can be powered at T1 (2bps+slippage); min detectable edge for a future traded verdict is 2x round-trip cost (~4bps) at t>=2; this spec is measurement-only, no traded verdict claimed.
spec.prerequisite: BLOCKED: factory.py needs Kalshi+Polymarket public-API loader and resolution-text matcher before this can pass validate_spec.
